manifest.name: Django
manifest.database_layer: Django ORM with psycopg 3.3 (C extension); persistent connections (CONN_MAX_AGE), one per thread, 16 in total
manifest.logging: none (Gunicorn's access log is off; Django logs only warnings and errors)

phase2.validation: <int:id> path converter (404); Django forms for the query string (Form(request.GET)), the JSON body (Form(json.loads(body)), plus a JSON integer check) and the form (Form(request.POST)): 422; malformed JSON 400

csrf.mechanism: CsrfViewMiddleware: secret in the csrftoken cookie, masked csrfmiddlewaretoken field, Origin checked when present; 403

session.mechanism: django.contrib.auth (LoginView, AuthenticationMiddleware) with the database session backend (django_session); custom user model on users, BCryptPasswordHasher

manifest.structure_note: Python 3.15.2, the newest Django 6.1 supports (FastAPI runs 3.14.10)
manifest.notes: startproject settings with the deployment checklist applied; HTTPS settings stay off (no TLS).

manifest.name: Axum
manifest.workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
manifest.database_layer: SQLx 0.9 (Axum has no ORM; its examples use SQLx)

phase2.validation: Path, Query, Json and Form extractors (type errors: 400, Json data errors 422); ranges checked by hand (422)

csrf.mechanism: axum_csrf 0.12 (token in an encrypted cookie, HMAC in the form field)

manifest.notes: Baseline: every job measures it on the same runner as the framework under test.
